_comment: Hand-verified opt-out endpoints. priority 5 = highest impact (widely scraped or feeds other brokers). method: web_form | email | web_form_captcha | account_required | postal | phone. Merged with the Optery list by scripts/build_registry.py

brokers.name: Spokeo
brokers.notes: Search for your profile first, paste profile URL + email.

brokers.name: Whitepages
brokers.notes: Requires phone call verification with an automated code at the end.

brokers.name: Radaris
brokers.notes: Requires claiming the profile; often needs phone verification.

brokers.name: PeopleFinders
brokers.notes: Web opt-out is behind a Cloudflare challenge. Policy states opt-outs are NOT accepted by email/mail - the form is the sanctioned route, but email is accepted to document that the form failed. privacy@peoplefinders.com BOUNCES (550). Correct public contact per CA data broker registration is customercare@peoplefinders.com; affiliate is privacy@peoplefindersdaas.com. Phone (800) 718-8997.

brokers.name: Intelius (PeopleConnect)
brokers.notes: PeopleConnect family: covers Intelius, US Search, ZabaSearch, Classmates.

brokers.name: ZoomInfo
brokers.notes: B2B data; requires email verification of the address on file.

brokers.name: Acxiom
brokers.notes: Major aggregator - feeds many downstream brokers.

brokers.name: LexisNexis
brokers.notes: May require proof of identity. Also file a separate security freeze.

brokers.name: OptOutPrescreen (credit offers)
brokers.notes: Joint Equifax/Experian/TransUnion/Innovis prescreen opt-out. Requires SSN for permanent opt-out - use the 5-year electronic option instead.
